_about: Sal, 2026-10-31; read by the server (server_items.gd _goals_data) and shown in the Journal. Starter goals for the first island, taken from TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md (the guide's text is the source of truth for hint wording). Format for a coder: `goals` is an ordered list; each goal has `id`, `title`, `hint` (plain text shown in the goal list), `after` (goal ids that must be done first; empty = available at start), `check` (one of: {event, count, what?} fired by the server when the thing happens, {have_item, count} true while the pack holds that many, {made_item, count} counted when a craft finishes, {got_item, count} counted when the player gathers it first-hand (not trades, rewards, refunds or admin gives), {have_item_any, count}), and `stage` (the progression stage; the goal pays that stage's copper from data/items/goal_rewards.json, coins only). A goal completes once and is saved per character (characters.json `goals_done`). Events to emit in server_items.gd: drink, tree_felled, fire_lit, ate_food, placed(what), carcass_worked. The metal path (charcoal through steel_tool, appended 21 Nov 2026, coordinator decision D-GOAL-1 under Dave's rule of 21 Nov) leads from the stone camp to copper, tin and bronze, iron, then steel; its ore hints follow the ore layout and are reworded when that layout changes.

goals.title: Drink at the water
goals.hint: Walk to the water's edge and press E to drink.

goals.title: Gather plant fibre
goals.hint: Nettles and tall grass give plant fibre. Press E on a plant.

goals.title: Twist twine
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I), pick Twine and craft it: 3 plant fibre make 1 twine.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Axe
goals.hint: 1 stone, 1 stick and 2 twine make a Stone - Axe. Put it on the hotbar to use it.

goals.title: Fell a tree
goals.hint: Hold the axe and strike a tree again and again. It breaks into logs, sticks and leaves when it lands.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Hammer
goals.hint: Make a Stone - Hammer from a stone, a stick and a twine. You build and repair with it, and it breaks stone and ore from boulders.

goals.title: Light a fire
goals.hint: Make a Campfire (6 sticks, 16 stones) and place it. Put sticks on it with F, then press E near it to light it.

goals.title: Make a hoe
goals.hint: A hoe treads paths and breaks ground for beds. Craft one in the inventory (I): a Wooden - Hoe is 2 sticks and a twine (keep a stone in your pack).

goals.title: Tread a path from camp to the water
goals.hint: Hold the hoe and left click along the ground from your fire towards the water. Or Shift + right click to drop survey markers as you walk and the road builds itself. Paths are faster to walk.

goals.title: Eat something wild
goals.hint: Pick berries or fruit with E and eat them. Put raw meat in the fire with F; cook plants in a pot.

goals.title: Build a lean-to
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Lean-to: 20 sticks, 60 leaves and 6 twine. Build it with the open side towards you.

goals.title: Make a bed
goals.hint: Make a bed and place it in your lean-to: a Thatch - Bed from your pack (10 thatch from thatch grass or heather, 4 sticks, 2 twine), or a Straw - Bed with the hammer. Any bed counts.

goals.title: Build a Workbench
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Workbench: 16 sticks, 6 twine and 8 stones. At it you make cobblestones, stone blocks, wooden pins, the flint scraper and more.

goals.title: Make a spear
goals.hint: A Wooden - Spear (1 stick, keep a stone) then 2 twine for a Stone - Spear.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Knife and work a kill
goals.hint: 2 stones and a stick make a knife. Strike a rabbit with the spear, then work the body with the knife.

goals.title: Catch a fish
goals.hint: Make a fishing rod (2 sticks, 2 twine and a hook carved from a bone) or a fishing net (3 rope, 4 stones) and fish at the water.

goals.title: Sell to Hob
goals.hint: Hob the trader buys what you pick. Talk to him with E, ask what he sells, and sell him a lot of stones.

goals.title: Fill Hob's order
goals.hint: Ask Hob: Any order for today? Pick what he wants and bring it back. He pays once a day.

goals.title: Save some charcoal
goals.hint: Burn firewood or logs on your campfire: the wood leaves charcoal in the fire. Take it out and keep it. Smelters and smithies burn charcoal or coal.

goals.title: Find copper ore
goals.hint: Copper ore is rock coated green or blue-green. Follow a river or stream inland and upstream: copper rocks lie along the water, more and bigger toward the hills. Pick small pieces up with E; break bigger rocks with the Stone - Hammer.

goals.title: Build a Primitive smelter
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Primitive smelter: 24 clay and 20 stones. Dig clay with a shovel where the ground is clay or under wet lowland soil.

goals.title: Smelt copper
goals.hint: Put copper ore in the Primitive smelter and charcoal or coal in its fuel slot (F), then press E to light it. Each copper ore gives a Copper ingot.

goals.title: Build a Primitive smithy
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Primitive smithy: 24 stones, 10 clay and 2 logs. Keep charcoal or coal in its fuel slot; copper and bronze tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make a copper tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make a Copper - Pickaxe (3 copper ingots, 2 sticks) or another copper tool. Copper tools work faster and last longer than stone.

goals.title: Find tin ore
goals.hint: Tin ore is a dark, very heavy rock, rarer than copper and farther inland. Look in river beds below the high hills and follow the finds upstream to where they come from. Break it like copper ore.

goals.title: Smelt bronze
goals.hint: Put copper ore and tin ore in the Primitive smelter together: each copper ore with a tin ore makes two Bronze ingots.

goals.title: Make a bronze tool
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make a Bronze - Pickaxe (3 bronze ingots, 2 sticks) or another bronze tool. A bronze pick can break iron rock.

goals.title: Build an Improved smelter
goals.hint: At the Primitive smithy make Bronze nails and Bronze hinges, then hold your hammer, press R and pick Improved smelter: 24 clay, 32 stones, 2 logs, 3 hides, 2 bronze hinges and 20 bronze nails. Its bellows let it smelt iron.

goals.title: Find iron ore
goals.hint: Iron is common almost everywhere. Pick up rusty iron stones along rivers, dig rust-red bog iron with a shovel in wet fen and marsh ground, or break rusty iron rock with a bronze or better pick.

goals.title: Smelt iron
goals.hint: Put iron ore and fuel in the Improved smelter, light it with E, then press E again to work its bellows: iron only smelts while someone works them. Two bog iron ore make 1 Iron ingot.

goals.title: Build an Improved smithy
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Improved smithy: 32 stones, 10 clay, 4 logs, 6 bronze ingots, 20 bronze nails and 2 bronze hinges. Iron tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make an iron tool
goals.hint: At the Improved smithy make an Iron - Pickaxe (3 iron ingots, 2 sticks) or another iron tool.

goals.title: Build an Advanced smelter
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Advanced smelter: 40 bricks, 40 stones, 8 mortar and 6 iron ingots. Its windmill drives its bellows, and it makes steel.

goals.title: Make steel
goals.hint: Put iron ore in the Advanced smelter with 1 coal or charcoal on each ore in its input as carbon, fuel in its hopper, and light it while the wind blows.

goals.title: Build an Advanced smithy
goals.hint: Make an Iron anvil at the Improved smithy (5 iron ingots, 1 log), then hold your hammer, press R and pick Advanced smithy. Steel tools are made at it.

goals.title: Make a steel tool
goals.hint: At the Advanced smithy make a Steel - Pickaxe (3 steel ingots, 2 sticks) or another steel tool.
